{{Quote|Corellian Traffic Control, this is Freighter PBY-1457, on approach to Corellia. Requesting landing and berthing instructions and permission&mdash;|Belindi Kalinda|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
'''Corellian Traffic Control''', later known as the '''Air Traffic Control''', was a branch of the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]] that monitored space traffic above [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==History==
In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Belindi Kalenda]] contacted Corellian Traffic Control in order to request landing instructions, but was fired upon instead.<ref name="AaC" />

When [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] traveled to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], they detected his ship as a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] due to the fact that his [[decoy system]] was still activated.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>
